title: Coming earlier on May 11th!
excerpt: Outbound will now release earlier on May 11th on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox, to avoid competing with Subnautica 2. The demo goes offline on May 8th.

title: Demo Version 1.0.0.9
excerpt: Patch notes for Demo Version 1.0.0.9: volume adjustments, new volume sliders, environmental sound fixes, and a missing campfire map icon.

title: Demo Version 1.0.0.8
excerpt: Patch notes for Demo Version 1.0.0.8: building rotation memory, version mismatch check, landmark tracking fix, and unstuck stability.

title: Demo Version 1.0.0.7

title: Demo Version 1.0.0.6
